details.description: Rich, aromatic, and perfectly blended for the South Indian filter coffee experience, Sri Krishna Sweets' Coffee Powder is a carefully crafted blend of premium coffee beans roasted and ground to deliver a bold, satisfying cup every time. Whether you prefer your coffee strong or mild, this blend delivers the authentic South Indian filter coffee flavour that coffee lovers crave.
details.usageInstructions: Brew in a traditional South Indian filter coffee maker. Pour the decoction into hot milk, sweeten to taste, and enjoy in a traditional davara-tumbler set for the authentic experience. Best enjoyed fresh and piping hot.

details.description: Experience the legendary taste of Kumbakonam filter coffee, one of South India's most celebrated coffee traditions. Sri Krishna Sweets' Kumbakonam Filter Coffee is a carefully crafted blend of premium coffee beans, roasted and ground to deliver the rich, bold, and deeply aromatic cup that Kumbakonam is famous for. One sip and you will understand why this coffee has a cult following.
details.usageInstructions: Brew in a traditional South Indian filter coffee maker. Pour the decoction into hot milk, sweeten to taste, and enjoy in a traditional davara-tumbler set for the authentic experience. Best enjoyed fresh and piping hot.

details.description: Bold, tangy, and deeply aromatic — Sri Krishna Sweets' Garlic Pickle is a South Indian classic that brings fiery, pungent garlic together with a rich blend of spices and oil. Every spoonful is a burst of robust flavour that pairs perfectly with rice, curd rice, rotis, and more.
details.usageInstructions: Serve a small portion alongside hot rice and ghee, curd rice, or plain rotis. A little goes a long way — the bold garlic and spice flavours are wonderfully intense. Also great as a side with parathas or as a flavour booster in curries.

details.description: Sri Krishna Sweets' Classic Soan Papdi is a timeless Indian sweet that has delighted generations. Each piece is beautifully flaky and airy, with a melt-in-the-mouth texture that dissolves into a warm, buttery sweetness the moment it touches your tongue. Made with pure ghee and studded with whole cashews and plump dry grapes, this is Soan Papdi as it was always meant to be — indulgent, aromatic, and deeply satisfying. Rooted in tradition since 1948.
details.ingredients: Sugar, Ghee, Refined Wheat Flour, Cashew, Dry Grapes.
details.usageInstructions: Best enjoyed at room temperature to fully appreciate the flaky, ghee-rich texture. Break off a piece and let it dissolve on your tongue. Pairs wonderfully with a cup of masala chai or South Indian filter coffee.

details.description: India's most beloved premium sweet, Sri Krishna Sweets' Kaju Katli is made from finely ground cashews pressed into thin, diamond-shaped slices that melt on the tongue with a wave of rich, buttery cashew flavour. Simple, elegant, and utterly irresistible, this is the sweet that defines celebration in India.
details.usageInstructions: Savour as a premium post-meal sweet, a festive treat, or a luxurious gift for loved ones. The classic diamond shape makes it a visually stunning addition to any festive sweet box. Pairs beautifully with a cup of masala chai.

details.description: Tangy, spiced, and deeply flavourful, Sri Krishna Sweets' Mango Thokku Pickle is a South Indian classic made from raw mangoes grated and slow-cooked with a blend of traditional spices. The thokku format gives this pickle a smooth, spreadable consistency that makes it wonderfully versatile and easy to use.
details.usageInstructions: Serve as a side with idly, dosa, chapati, or rice. Also great as a spread for sandwiches and wraps, or as a flavour booster for curries and gravies. A spoonful alongside curd rice is a classic South Indian combination.

details.description: Tangy, spiced, and packed with the natural goodness of amla (Indian gooseberry), Sri Krishna Sweets' Amla Pickle is a traditional condiment that is as nutritious as it is delicious. Amla is one of nature's richest sources of Vitamin C, and this pickle is a wonderful way to enjoy its benefits alongside bold, traditional South Indian flavours.
details.usageInstructions: Serve as a side with rice, idly, dosa, or chapati. A small spoonful alongside curd rice is a classic combination. Also great as a condiment with snacks and fried foods.

details.description: Light, crispy, and delicately flavoured, Sri Krishna Sweets' Elaivadam Plain are traditional South Indian rice vadams in their classic, unspiced form. These leaf-shaped (elai means leaf) vadams fry up to a wonderfully light and airy snack that is perfect for those who prefer a milder, more delicate flavour.
details.usageInstructions: Deep fry in hot oil until puffed and crispy. Drain on paper and enjoy as a standalone snack or serve as a side with rice and sambar. Season with a pinch of salt if desired. Also great as a crunchy topping for chaats.

details.description: A South Indian kitchen classic, Sri Krishna Sweets' Ribbon Vadam are thin, ribbon-shaped rice vadams that fry up to a light, crispy, and airy snack in seconds. details.description: Sri Krishna Sweets' Appalam Chips Pepper is the spicier, bolder sibling of the classic Appalam Chips Special. Every strip delivers the familiar comfort of a traditional appalam with an added peppery warmth that lingers pleasantly on the palate. A must-have for those who like their snacks with a little extra kick.

details.description: The perfect blend of bright citrus and warming spice, Sri Krishna Sweets' Lemon Ginger Sharbat combines the refreshing tang of lemon with the invigorating warmth of ginger. details.description: Golden, aromatic, and made with the finest quality cow milk, Sri Krishna Sweets' Pure Cow Ghee is a kitchen essential that elevates every dish it touches. Made using traditional methods to preserve the natural richness and aroma of pure ghee, this is the kind of ghee that makes rice, rotis, and sweets taste truly special.
details.usageInstructions: Drizzle over hot rice, dal, and rotis for an instant flavour boost. Use for tempering spices in curries and gravies. Add to sweets and halwas for richness and aroma. Also wonderful spread on hot phulkas and parathas.

details.description: Tangy, spiced, and deeply flavourful, Sri Krishna Sweets' Tomato Thokku is a South Indian relish made from ripe tomatoes slow-cooked with a blend of traditional spices. The natural acidity of tomatoes combined with the warmth of chilli and mustard creates a thokku that is vibrant, versatile, and utterly delicious.
details.usageInstructions: Serve as a side with idly, dosa, chapati, or rice. Also great as a spread for sandwiches and wraps, or as a flavour booster for curries and gravies. A spoonful alongside curd rice is a classic South Indian combination.

details.description: Light, crispy, and wonderfully flavourful, Sri Krishna Sweets' Aval Mixture features the wholesome goodness of aval (flattened rice) as its star ingredient. The aval adds a unique lightness and texture to this South Indian snack blend, making it a refreshing and satisfying choice for everyday snacking.
details.usageInstructions: Enjoy with a hot cup of filter coffee or tea as an evening snack. Serve in a bowl for guests, pack into tiffin boxes, or gift as part of a festive snack hamper. Also a traditional offering during Krishna Jayanthi.

details.description: A beloved Andhra staple, Sri Krishna Sweets' Verusenaga Podi is a flavourful spiced peanut powder that transforms a simple meal into something special. Made from roasted peanuts ground with red chillies, garlic, and spices, this podi delivers a bold, nutty heat that pairs beautifully with rice, idly, and dosa.
details.usageInstructions: Mix with ghee or sesame oil and serve alongside hot rice, idly, or dosa. Also great as a dry chutney with breakfast dishes. A little goes a long way, making this a versatile and long-lasting pantry staple.

details.description: A beloved Andhra staple, Sri Krishna Sweets' Pappula Podi is a flavourful spiced powder made from roasted chana dal (pappula), red chillies, and garlic. Light, nutty, and boldly spiced, this podi is a versatile condiment that adds a wonderful depth of flavour to rice, idly, and dosa.
details.usageInstructions: Mix with ghee or sesame oil and serve alongside hot rice, idly, or dosa. Also great as a dry chutney with breakfast dishes. A little goes a long way, making this a versatile and long-lasting pantry staple.

details.description: Rich, nutty, and warmly spiced, Sri Krishna Sweets' Nuvulu Podi is an authentic Andhra-style sesame seed powder that adds a wonderful depth of flavour to everyday meals. Nuvulu means sesame in Telugu, and this podi celebrates the earthy richness of roasted sesame with a perfectly balanced spice blend.
details.usageInstructions: Mix with ghee or sesame oil and serve alongside hot rice, idly, or dosa. Also great as a dry chutney with breakfast dishes. A little goes a long way, making this a versatile and long-lasting pantry staple.

details.description: Comforting, nourishing, and deeply traditional, Sri Krishna Sweets' Kanjee Mavu is a classic South Indian rice porridge flour that has been a staple of Tamil households for generations. Simple to prepare and wonderfully soothing, kanjee is the kind of breakfast that warms you from the inside out.
details.usageInstructions: Mix with water or milk and cook to a smooth porridge consistency. Sweeten with jaggery or palm candy for a traditional sweet kanjee, or enjoy savoury with a pinch of salt and a drizzle of ghee. A comforting and nourishing breakfast for all ages.

title: Sukku Malli Coffee Powder with Palm Candy

details.description: Warm your body and soothe your senses with Sri Krishna Sweets' Sukku Malli Coffee Powder. A traditional South Indian herbal brew made with dry ginger (sukku), coriander seeds (malli), and other warming spices, paired with natural palm candy for a gentle sweetness. This is the kind of drink your grandmother made on rainy evenings, and now you can enjoy it anytime.
details.usageInstructions: Boil one teaspoon of the powder in water or milk, strain, and sweeten with the included palm candy to taste. Enjoy hot as a comforting morning or evening drink. Especially soothing during cold weather or when you need a gentle digestive boost.

details.description: Crispy, crunchy, and shaped like a star, Sri Krishna Sweets' Mullu Murukku is a South Indian festival favourite that has delighted generations. Made from rice flour and seasoned with traditional spices, each piece delivers a satisfying snap and an authentic flavour that takes you straight back to festive celebrations at home.
details.usageInstructions: Enjoy with a hot cup of filter coffee or tea as an evening snack. A must-have during Krishna Jayanthi, Diwali, and other South Indian festivals. Also great for gifting and sharing with loved ones.

details.description: Hand-pressed and seasoned with freshly crushed black pepper, this ultra-crispy thattai delivers a bold, aromatic expression of South Indian spice tradition. Sri Krishna Sweets' Milagu Thattai is crafted with care using time-honoured techniques, giving you that satisfying crunch and authentic flavour in every bite.
details.usageInstructions: Enjoy straight from the pack as a tea-time snack. Pairs perfectly with a cup of filter coffee or masala chai. Great for sharing with family or as a festive snack for guests.

details.description: Hollow, crispy, and deeply satisfying, Sri Krishna Sweets' Classic Kuzhal Murukku is a timeless South Indian snack that needs no introduction. Made from rice flour and seasoned with traditional spices, these tube-shaped murukku pieces deliver a light, airy crunch that is impossible to resist.
details.usageInstructions: Enjoy with a hot cup of filter coffee or tea as an evening snack. A festive staple during Krishna Jayanthi and Diwali. Also great for gifting and sharing at family gatherings.

details.description: Bold, spicy, and deeply flavourful, Sri Krishna Sweets' Nellai Mixture draws inspiration from the vibrant culinary traditions of Tirunelveli (Nellai). This robust snack blend packs a punch with its signature spice profile, making it a favourite for those who love their snacks with a real kick.
details.usageInstructions: Best enjoyed with a hot cup of filter coffee or tea as an evening snack. Serve in a bowl for guests, pack into tiffin boxes, or gift as part of a festive snack hamper.

details.description: Sri Krishna Sweets' Garlic Dhall Powder is a fragrant, flavour-packed condiment that combines the warmth of roasted garlic with the richness of dhall. Bold, earthy, and deeply aromatic, this powder transforms simple everyday meals into something extraordinary. Best enjoyed mixed into hot rice with a generous drizzle of ghee, it is the kind of comfort food that brings the taste of home to every meal.
details.usageInstructions: Mix into hot rice with ghee for a quick, satisfying meal. Use as a flavourful seasoning for dosas, idlis, or rotis. Sprinkle over upma or poha for an extra punch of flavour.

details.description: The classic South Indian breakfast essential, Sri Krishna Sweets' Idly Chilli Powder is a perfectly balanced idly podi made from a traditional blend of lentils, red chillies, and aromatic spices. Simple, authentic, and deeply satisfying, this podi is the kind of condiment that makes every idly and dosa taste better.
details.usageInstructions: Mix with sesame oil or ghee and serve alongside hot idly, dosa, or rice. A little goes a long way in adding a bold, spiced flavour to your breakfast. Also great as a dry chutney with other South Indian breakfast dishes.

details.description: Light, crispy, and shaped like a smooth coil, Sri Krishna Sweets' Thenkuzhal Murukku is a South Indian festive staple that has been loved for generations. Made from rice flour and seasoned with cumin and other traditional spices, this murukku delivers a clean, satisfying crunch with every bite.
details.usageInstructions: Enjoy with a hot cup of filter coffee or tea as an evening snack. A must-have during Krishna Jayanthi, Diwali, and other South Indian festivals. Also great for gifting and sharing at family gatherings.

details.description: Tiny, crispy, and packed with flavour, Sri Krishna Sweets' Classic Kara Boondhi is a South Indian tea-time staple that never goes out of style. Made from gram flour and seasoned with a blend of spices, these little golden pearls deliver a satisfying crunch and a bold, savoury kick in every handful.
details.usageInstructions: Enjoy with a hot cup of filter coffee or tea as an evening snack. Also a classic component in South Indian mixture recipes. Serve in a bowl for guests or pack as a festive snack gift.

details.description: Thin, crispy, and wonderfully aromatic, Sri Krishna Sweets' Omapodi is a South Indian classic that has stood the test of time. Made from gram flour and flavoured with ajwain (omam), these fine noodle-shaped savouries deliver a satisfying crunch and a distinctive herbal warmth that pairs perfectly with a hot cup of tea.
details.usageInstructions: Enjoy as a standalone tea-time snack or use as a crunchy topping for bhel puri and chaats. Also a classic component in South Indian mixture recipes. Serve in a bowl for guests or pack as a festive snack gift.

details.description: A nutty, mildly spiced idly podi with the distinctive richness of white sesame seeds, Sri Krishna Sweets' White Sesame Idly Chilly Powder is a wonderful variation on the classic South Indian breakfast condiment. The sesame adds a warm, toasty depth that makes this podi particularly satisfying and aromatic.
details.usageInstructions: Mix with sesame oil or ghee and serve alongside hot idly, dosa, or rice. A little goes a long way in adding a nutty, spiced flavour to your breakfast. Also great as a dry chutney with other South Indian breakfast dishes.

details.description: Bring warmth and aroma to every meal with Sri Krishna Sweets' Idly Dhaniya Chilli Powder — a beautifully balanced blend of roasted coriander (dhaniya) and red chillies, ground to a fine, fragrant powder. It's the kind of condiment that turns an ordinary breakfast into something truly special.
details.usageInstructions: Mix with sesame oil or ghee and serve alongside hot idlies, dosas, or uttapams. Also delicious stirred into plain rice with a spoonful of ghee for a quick, comforting meal. Use as a dry chutney powder for a flavour-packed side.

details.description: Sri Krishna Sweets' Chettinadu Kaara Kuzhambu Paste brings the bold, complex flavours of authentic Chettinad cuisine straight to your kitchen. Crafted from a traditional blend of regional spices — the kind that have been passed down through generations in the kitchens of Chettinad — this rich, deep-red paste delivers an intense, fiery gravy that deepens in flavour with every simmer. Whether you're a seasoned cook or a busy home chef, this 400g jar makes it effortless to bring the real taste of Chettinad to your table in minutes.
details.usageInstructions: Simply heat oil in a pan, add the paste, and simmer with water or tamarind water to your desired consistency. Serve hot over steaming rice for the classic Kaara Kuzhambu experience. Also delicious as a spread on crispy dosa, layered with soft idli, rolled into chapathi, or enjoyed as a bold, zesty chutney.

details.description: Crispy, boldly spiced, and wonderfully satisfying, Sri Krishna Sweets' Ribbon Pakkoda is a classic South Indian snack made from gram flour and rice flour, extruded into flat ribbon shapes and fried to a perfect, crunchy finish. Each ribbon delivers a satisfying snap and a rich, savoury flavour that makes it impossible to stop at just one.
details.usageInstructions: Enjoy with a hot cup of filter coffee or tea as an evening snack. A festive essential during Krishna Jayanthi and Diwali. Also great for gifting and sharing at family gatherings.

details.description: Experience the authentic crunch of Chennai in every handful. Sri Krishna Sweets' Madras Mixture — also known as Mota Mixture — is a beloved South Indian snack blend packed with crispy sev, fried lentils, peanuts, and savoury bites, all tossed in a signature spice blend that keeps you reaching for more.
details.usageInstructions: Best enjoyed as an evening snack with a hot cup of tea or filter coffee. Serve in a bowl for guests, pack into tiffin boxes, or simply snack straight from the pack. Also makes a great topping for chaats and bhel.

details.description: Take your snacking to the next level with Sri Krishna Sweets' Special Mixture — an exclusive, house-crafted blend of crispy savouries, spiced nuts, and crunchy bites that you simply won't find anywhere else. Each handful delivers a medley of textures and bold flavours that make it impossible to stop at just one.
details.usageInstructions: Enjoy as an evening snack with filter coffee or masala chai. Serve at parties, pack for travel, or gift to loved ones during festivals. Also makes a delicious topping for yoghurt-based chaats.

details.description: Bold, peppery, and wonderfully crispy, Sri Krishna Sweets' Milagu Karasev is a South Indian classic for those who love a real spice kick. Made from gram flour and generously seasoned with freshly ground black pepper (milagu), each strand delivers a sharp, warming heat that lingers pleasantly on the palate.
details.usageInstructions: Enjoy with a hot cup of filter coffee or tea as an evening snack. Also a great addition to South Indian mixture recipes or as a crunchy topping for chaats. Serve in a bowl for guests or pack as a festive snack gift.

details.description: Crafted by hand with skill and tradition, Sri Krishna Sweets' Kai Murukku is the gold standard of South Indian murukku. Each piece is hand-pressed (kai means hand) from a blend of rice flour and spices, resulting in a uniquely textured, crispy murukku that carries the warmth of artisanal craftsmanship in every bite.
details.usageInstructions: Enjoy with a hot cup of filter coffee or tea as an evening snack. A festive essential during Krishna Jayanthi, Diwali, and other South Indian celebrations. Also makes a wonderful gift for murukku lovers.

details.description: Sri Krishna Sweets' Classic Thattai is the quintessential South Indian snack — thin, golden, and impossibly crispy. Known affectionately as "Chinna Chinna Thattai" for its perfectly petite size, each piece is made from rice flour and a blend of traditional spices, fried in pure groundnut oil for that authentic flavour and satisfying crunch. Freshness-sealed in our signature white pouch, this is the snack that has been a part of Chennai homes since 1948. One bite and you'll know why it's a classic.
details.usageInstructions: Best enjoyed as a standalone snack with a hot cup of filter coffee or masala chai. Serve in a brass bowl on a banana leaf for a truly traditional experience. Also makes a wonderful crunchy accompaniment to curd rice or sambar rice.

details.description: Sri Krishna Sweets' Butter Murukku is the snack that Chennai has loved for generations. Made from rice flour, Bengal gram flour, and real butter, seasoned with cumin seeds and asafoetida, and fried to a perfect golden crisp in pure groundnut oil — every strand delivers a rich, buttery crunch that is simply impossible to resist. Freshness-sealed in our signature teal pouch, this is the Butter Murukku that has been a staple in Chennai homes since 1948. One handful and you'll understand why.
details.ingredients: Rice Flour, Edible Vegetable Oil (Groundnut Oil), Bengal Gram Flour, Butter, Urad Dhal Flour, Edible Common Salt, Cumin Seeds, Asafoetida.
details.usageInstructions: Best enjoyed as a standalone snack with a hot cup of filter coffee or masala chai. Serve in a silver or brass bowl on a banana leaf for a traditional festive touch. Also makes a wonderful crunchy addition to snack spreads and gift hampers.

details.description: The sweet that built Sri Krishna Sweets' legendary reputation, our Mysurpa is a masterpiece of South Indian confectionery. Made with pure ghee, fine sugar, and the finest gram flour, each piece is slow-cooked to a perfect, melt-in-the-mouth consistency that has kept customers coming back for generations. This is not just a sweet — it is a Chennai institution.
details.usageInstructions: Savour as a premium post-meal sweet, a festive treat, or a luxurious gift for loved ones. Best enjoyed at room temperature to fully appreciate the rich, ghee-laden flavour. Pairs beautifully with a cup of filter coffee.
